reason: instrument bug: git ls-files returns nothing inside a Docker copy of a worktree, so the glob corpus was empty and 18 rules were falsely accused. Replaced with a filesystem walk plus a COULD-NOT-RUN guard. No expectation changed -- the expectation was and remains 'no scoped rule has only dead globs'.
